---
title: "Business Requirements"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r load-data, include = FALSE}
source("br_utils.R", local = TRUE)
brs <- read_brs("business_requirements.yml")
br_abbrs <- extract_br_abbrs(brs)
br_imgs <- read_br_imgs()
```

```{r generate-br-report, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
purrr::iwalk(brs, function(br_list, category_name) {
  cat(paste0("## ", category_name, "\n\n"))
  category_abbr <- br_abbrs[category_name]
  purrr::iwalk(br_list, function(br_description, br_id) {
    cat(paste0("### ", br_id, ": ", br_description, "\n\n"))
    if (category_abbr %in% names(br_imgs)) {
      img_paths <- br_imgs[[category_abbr]][[br_id]]
      if (!is.null(img_paths)) {
        cat(glue::glue("![]({img_paths})"), sep = "\n")
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  })
})
```
